exports.name: AsyncDetection
exports.summary:
Companion directive for `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` that watches the content for
DOM mutations (via `ContentObserver`) and re-triggers scrollbar layout updates.
exports.summaryZh:
用于 `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` 的配套指令，通过 `ContentObserver` 监听内容的
DOM 变化，并重新触发滚动条布局更新。

properties.name: asyncDetection
properties.description:
`'auto'` to keep watching for viewport/content-wrapper/spacer element changes indefinitely,
or `''` (default) to stop watching once found once.
properties.descriptionZh: `'auto'` 表示持续监听视口/内容包裹层/占位符元素的变化，`''`（默认）表示找到一次后即停止监听。

exports.name: NgScrollbar
exports.summary:
Custom scrollbar component: wraps projected content in an internally-managed scrollable
viewport and renders custom scrollbar overlays over it.
exports.summaryZh: 自定义滚动条组件：将投影内容包裹在内部管理的可滚动视口中，并在其上渲染自定义滚动条覆层。

properties.name: contentWrapper
properties.descriptionZh: 内部内容包裹层元素的引用。

exports.name: NgScrollbarExt
exports.summary:
`ng-scrollbar` variant that renders custom scrollbar overlays on top of an *external*
viewport element (`[scrollViewport]`) that you control, instead of an internal one.
exports.summaryZh:
`ng-scrollbar` 的外部视口版本，在你自行提供的外部视口元素（`[scrollViewport]`）上方
渲染自定义滚动条覆层，而不是使用内部视口。

inputs.name: skipInit
inputs.description:
Skip initializing the viewport and the scrollbar
this is used when the component needs to wait for 3rd party library to render

properties.name: externalViewport
properties.description: Selector used to query the viewport element.

properties.name: externalContentWrapper
properties.description: Selector used to query the content wrapper element.

properties.name: externalSpacer
properties.description:
Selector used to query the spacer element (virtual scroll integration).
In the case of integrating the scrollbar with a virtual scroll component,
a spacer element is typically created to match the real size of the content.
The scrollbar will use the size of this spacer element for calculations instead of the content wrapper size.

properties.name: altViewport
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，由 {@link AsyncDetection} 等辅助指令写入的视口元素覆盖值。

properties.name: altContentWrapper
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，由 {@link AsyncDetection} 等辅助指令写入的内容包裹层元素覆盖值。

properties.name: altSpacer
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，由 {@link AsyncDetection} 等辅助指令写入的占位符元素覆盖值。

properties.name: viewportElement
properties.description:
The resolved external viewport element (from `[scrollViewport]`, `altViewport`, or the
`externalViewport` selector).
properties.descriptionZh: 解析出的外部视口元素（来自 `[scrollViewport]`、`altViewport` 或 `externalViewport` 选择器）。

properties.name: viewportError
properties.description: A diagnostic error message if the external viewport element couldn't be resolved, else `null`.
properties.descriptionZh: 若外部视口元素解析失败则给出诊断错误信息，否则为 `null`。

properties.name: contentWrapperElement
properties.descriptionZh: 解析出的外部内容包裹层元素。

properties.name: contentWrapperError
properties.description: A diagnostic error message if the external content-wrapper element couldn't be resolved, else `null`.
properties.descriptionZh: 若外部内容包裹层元素解析失败则给出诊断错误信息，否则为 `null`。

properties.name: spacerElement
properties.descriptionZh: 解析出的外部占位符元素。

properties.name: spacerError
properties.description: A diagnostic error message if the external spacer element couldn't be resolved, else `null`.
properties.descriptionZh: 若外部占位符元素解析失败则给出诊断错误信息，否则为 `null`。

properties.name: customViewport
properties.description: Reference to the external viewport directive if used

exports.name: NgScrollbarModule
exports.summary:
Convenience `NgModule` bundling {@link NgScrollbar}, {@link ScrollViewport},
{@link NgScrollbarExt}, `AsyncDetection` and `SyncSpacer` (all standalone) for NgModule-based apps.
exports.summaryZh:
便捷 `NgModule`，将 {@link NgScrollbar}、{@link ScrollViewport}、{@link NgScrollbarExt}、
`AsyncDetection`、`SyncSpacer`（均为 standalone）打包，供基于 NgModule 的应用使用。

exports.name: ScrollViewport
exports.summary:
Marks an element as the scrollable viewport that {@link NgScrollbarExt} should attach its
custom scrollbar overlay to.
exports.summaryZh: 将元素标记为 {@link NgScrollbarExt} 应附加自定义滚动条覆层的可滚动视口。

properties.name: nativeElement
properties.descriptionZh: 标记该指令所在的原生元素。

exports.name: SyncSpacer
exports.summary:
Companion directive for `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` that syncs a spacer element's
CSS custom properties (`--spacer-width`/`--spacer-height`) to the viewport's content size.
exports.summaryZh:
用于 `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` 的配套指令，将占位元素的 CSS 自定义属性
（`--spacer-width`/`--spacer-height`）与视口内容尺寸保持同步。

properties.name: spacerDimension
properties.description: A signal used to sync spacer dimension when content dimension changes
